description: This file defines the ResponseEmitter class in the Slim framework, responsible for emitting HTTP responses including headers, status line, and body to the client.

classes.name: ResponseEmitter
classes.description: Class responsible for emitting HTTP responses to the client, including headers, status line, and body.

methods.name: emit
methods.description: Sends the response to the client, including headers, status line, and body if not empty.

methods.name: emitHeaders
methods.description: Emits HTTP headers from the response.

methods.name: emitBody
methods.description: Emits the response body in chunks.

methods.name: isResponseEmpty
methods.description: Checks if the response body is empty or if the status code indicates no content.
